archetypes.name: dyn-postmerge-retry
archetypes.rationale: Post-merge retry routing touches CI rerun and Step 8 transient re-entry.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the postmerge push-watch changes in ship.py. Focus on whether failed merged-SHA runs rerun exactly once, preserve state needed for resume, and avoid masking real repeated failures. Check that Outcome.TRANSIENT integrates with existing route-exit behavior without introducing a new NEXT_ACTION. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
